items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I played with Rick when he had a band out there.

ctx.x: You played with some other bands there and I heard you with other bands.

Yeah well I played with uh, in Freddie's place in Freddie's band. Freddie Coleman had the band at the time and sometime he was, couldn't make it. I played in his place. I played with Rick when he had a band out there. I played at the paddock with several bands there. And I played with Thomas when Thomas had a band at the, what is the Club Slipper? Yeah, the Club Slipper. I played there. Which Thomas? Thomas Jefferson. When he had a band I played with him.
Did you ever leave town with a band?
